ag.help.mode:
Normal gathers for free and gives the common loot.
Focus spends about 20 Focus per gather for rarer loot and more Life Skill EXP. When you run out of Focus, gathering stops.
You can't change the mode while gathering.
ag.help.limit:
In Focus mode, gathering stops once this much Focus has been spent. The count starts from zero each time you press Start.
You can raise the limit while gathering to keep going. Drag it all the way right for no limit.
ag.help.popups: Closes the daily reward popup when it appears, so a long gathering session isn't interrupted.
